description: Canonical planning interchange shape (AD-6) — one entity per markdown file, YAML frontmatter, body markdown. The normalized _bmad-output/ planning artifacts carrying this shape are the single canonical local representation under every binding (AD-4); every backend adapter and migration maps to this contract and never extends it. The single shipped validator is lib/interchange.py — no adapter ships its own parser. Ids are minted only by the adapter from the committed per-project counter (AD-4); stable, never reused. Frontmatter must stay inside the lib/miniyaml.py subset: nested maps and lists of scalars only.

entity.unknown_keys: preserved and ignored — normalization repairs canonical keys in place without dropping upstream content (AD-4)

id.note: prefix must match type: EP-epic, ST-story, TA-task; minted only by the adapter, stable, never reused

status.note: CLOSED enum — adapters map onto backend states and never extend it; an unmappable backend state maps to the nearest canonical value with the original preserved under external.<binding>

parent.note: story -> its epic (EP-NNN); task -> its story (ST-NNN); an epic has no parent

depends_on.note: list of entity ids; no self-dependency, no duplicates

external.note: map: binding name -> sync snapshot (see external_entry); written only by the adapter's promote/pull-back (AD-5 echo suppression reads this snapshot)

key.note: backend-native identity (e.g. Backlog.md task id, Jira issue key)

content_hash.note: hash of the canonical content at last promote

external_entry.unknown_keys: allowed — backend-specific state (e.g. the original unmappable status) is preserved here

body.acceptance_criteria: convention: a '## Acceptance Criteria' section holding a markdown checklist; not enforced by the validator

backend_mappings.note: epic has no native entity in Backlog.md (-> milestone + label) and none in Linear (-> Project); in Jira epic->Epic, story->Story, task->Sub-task (AD-6, AD-7)

entity_marker: a markdown file is an interchange entity iff its frontmatter carries shape_version; files without it are skipped by directory validation (pre-normalization artifacts are stamped by the ST-3.2 normalize pass)
